body.zh-Hant: 迪亞斯1830年9月15日生於瓦哈卡市，是一位普通旅店主人的第六個孩子，德國國家圖書館權威檔也記他生於1830-09-15、卒於1915-07-02，職業為政治人物與將軍。他的父親在他三歲前去世；15歲起進神學院就讀，後來拒絕受聖職，堅持改學法律，1853年通過民法與教會法的第一次考試。
body.en: Díaz was born in the city of Oaxaca on 15 September 1830, the sixth child of a modest innkeeper; the German National Library authority record also gives 1830-09-15 and 1915-07-02 as his birth and death dates and lists him as politician and general. His father died before he turned three; at fifteen he began attending the seminary, and he later refused ordination and insisted on studying law, passing his first civil and canon law examination in 1853.

heading.en: From local official to anti-French commander

body.zh-Hant: 阿尤特拉計畫（1854）成功後，迪亞斯被任命為伊斯特蘭副省長，政治生涯由此開始；1861年8月升准將，同年當選國會議員，但任期很短。他因在1862年5月5日普埃布拉對入侵法軍的勝利中扮演關鍵角色而成名；1866年他持續對佔領的法軍打游擊，並於10月31日攻下瓦哈卡城；1867年他率東方軍團於4月2日在普埃布拉獲勝，並於6月21日把帝國軍隊逐出首都。
body.en: After the triumph of the Plan of Ayutla (1854), Díaz was named subprefect of Ixtlán, the beginning of his political career; he was promoted to brigadier general in August 1861 and elected to Congress that year, serving only briefly. He first achieved fame through his crucial role in the victory against the invading French troops at Puebla on 5 May 1862. Throughout 1866 he kept up guerrilla warfare against the occupying French army and took the city of Oaxaca on 31 October; in 1867 he led his Army of the East to victory at Puebla on 2 April and drove the imperial army from the capital on 21 June.

heading.zh-Hant: 兩度起兵與取得總統職
heading.en: Two rebellions and the road to the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 胡亞雷斯1867年連任後，迪亞斯辭去軍職，轉而經營農業並投入1871年的總統選舉；胡亞雷斯再度連任時他起兵，諾里亞計畫指選舉有舞弊並要求總統限任一屆，但他未能推翻胡亞雷斯。1876年1月他又起兵反對萊爾多，提出圖斯特佩克計畫；萊爾多辭職流亡後，迪亞斯舉行選舉，於1877年5月5日正式就任總統。
body.en: After Juárez's reelection in 1867 Díaz resigned from the army and turned to agriculture and the presidential election of 1871; with another reelection of Juárez he rebelled, and his Plan of la Noria claimed the election had been fraudulent and demanded that the presidency be limited to a single term, but he failed to dislodge Juárez. In January 1876 he rebelled against Lerdo with the Plan of Tuxtepec; after Lerdo resigned and went into exile, Díaz held elections and took formal possession of the presidency on 5 May 1877.

heading.en: Rule and the drift to dictatorship

body.zh-Hant: 第一任期末他遵守不再參選的承諾，改任曼努埃爾·岡薩雷斯總統手下的發展部長，並擔任瓦哈卡州長；1884年再度當選總統，其後於1888、1892、1904、1910年放棄反對連任的立場。他維持穩定、平衡預算並促進經濟成長，但使墨西哥更依賴外資；權力趨於獨裁，阻止對手當選並箝制新聞。1900年之後，因經濟蕭條、政治組織化等原因，這套體制開始瓦解。
body.en: At the end of his first term he kept his promise and did not run again, accepting the post of secretary of development under President Manuel González and serving as governor of Oaxaca; in 1884 he was elected president again, giving up his antipathy to reelection in 1888, 1892, 1904 and 1910. He provided stable government, balanced the budget and assured economic growth but increased Mexico's reliance on foreign capital; his power became dictatorial, he prevented the election of his opponents and muzzled the press. After 1900 the system began to fall apart as the result of economic depression, political organization and other factors.

body.zh-Hant: 1908年他接受美國記者詹姆斯·克里爾曼訪問，看似宣布墨西哥已準備好競爭性選舉、他不會再於1910年競選；後來他改變主意，但此番談話已引發轟動。最後他和當初取得權力時一樣，因游擊戰而失勢：1911年5月21日他的代表與馬德羅簽署華雷斯城條約，他於5月25日辭去總統職務，月底動身流亡巴黎，並在當地去世。
body.en: In 1908, in an interview with the U.S. reporter James Creelman, he appeared to announce that Mexico was ready for competitive elections and that he would not run for reelection in 1910; he later changed his mind, but the remarks had created a sensation. In the end he lost power the way he first gained it, through guerrilla warfare: on 21 May 1911 his representative signed the Treaty of Ciudad Juárez with Francisco Madero, he resigned the presidency on 25 May, and by the end of the month was on his way to exile in Paris, where he died.

heading.zh-Hant: 繼位、流亡與君主制廢除
heading.en: Accession, exile and the abolition of the monarchy

body.zh-Hant: 喬治二世是君士坦丁一世與王后蘇菲亞的長子。1922年小亞細亞戰役失敗後，君士坦丁被廢，由他繼位；1923年他被指涉入一次失敗的軍事政變而被迫離開希臘。議會宣布共和，1924年4月13日公民投票決定廢除君主制。德國國家圖書館權威檔記他1922至1924年與1935至1947年為希臘國王。
body.en: George II was the eldest son of King Constantine I and Queen Sophia. After the defeat in the Asia Minor campaign in 1922 Constantine was deposed and succeeded by his son; in 1923 George was allegedly involved in an abortive military coup and was forced to leave the country. Parliament declared a republic, and a plebiscite on 13 April 1924 abolished the monarchy. The German National Library authority record gives him as King of Greece in 1922–1924 and 1935–1947.

body.zh-Hant: 共和時期，君主派與共和派的對立主宰了兩次大戰之間的希臘政治。1932年韋尼澤洛斯在選舉中失敗後，君主派上台；在共和派兩次失敗的軍事政變之後，君主派於1935年策動政變以迎回國王，孔迪利斯將軍奪得獨裁權力並廢除共和。1935年11月3日一場被操縱的公民投票使喬治恢復王位。
body.en: Conflict between monarchists and republicans dominated Greek political life in the interwar years. After Venizelos's defeat in the 1932 elections the royalists came to power; after two abortive republican military coups the royalists organized a coup in 1935 to reinstate the king, General Kondylis seized dictatorial powers and abolished the republic, and after a rigged plebiscite on 3 November 1935 King George was restored.

body.zh-Hant: 1936年1月的選舉沒有讓任何政黨取得多數，小小的共產黨握有議會平衡權。1936年3月，喬治任命梅塔克薩斯將軍為首相；1936年8月4日，他同意梅塔克薩斯建立獨裁，以隔天預定的總罷工為藉口。他與這位獨裁者分享權力四年多，這一點成為其統治的標記並使其合法性遭到質疑。
body.en: The elections of January 1936 gave no party a majority and the small Communist Party held the balance of power in parliament. In March 1936 King George appointed General Ioannis Metaxas prime minister, and on 4 August 1936 he consented to Metaxas's dictatorship, using as a pretext a general strike scheduled for the following day. That he shared power with the dictator for more than four years marked his reign and questioned his legitimacy.

heading.en: War and the government in exile

body.zh-Hant: 1940年10月希臘先對義大利作戰，1941年4月再對德國作戰。梅塔克薩斯於1941年1月去世後，喬治任命科里齊斯為首相；1941年4月23日希臘向軸心國投降後，喬治與新首相措德羅斯先逃往亞歷山大，再經開普敦到倫敦；希臘流亡政府則遷往開羅。1944年5月黎巴嫩會議決定解放後就君主制舉行公民投票。
body.en: Greece fought first against Italy (October 1940) and then Germany (April 1941). After Metaxas died in January 1941 King George appointed Alexander Koryzis prime minister; after Greece capitulated to the Axis on 23 April 1941 he and the new prime minister Emmanuel Tsouderos fled first to Alexandria, then to Cape Town, and from there to London, while the government in exile moved to Cairo. At the Lebanon conference in May 1944 it was decided that a plebiscite on the monarchy would follow liberation.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年12月雅典的共產黨抵抗力量與政府軍交戰時，喬治在英國壓力下任命達馬斯基諾斯大主教為攝政。1946年9月1日的公民投票有69%支持國王回國，喬治於1946年9月28日返回希臘。他在1947年4月1日去世，由弟弟保羅繼位。
body.en: During the fighting in Athens between the communist resistance and government forces in December 1944, King George surrendered to British pressure and appointed Archbishop Damaskinos as regent. The plebiscite held on 1 September 1946 gave 69 percent for the return of the king, and George returned to Greece on 28 September 1946. He died on 1 April 1947 and was succeeded by his brother Paul.

body.zh-Hant: 佩索阿1865年5月23日生於帕拉伊巴州的溫布澤魯，1886年畢業於累西腓法學院，同年出任本若爾丁的公訴人。1889年他前往里約熱內盧；共和成立後，他被任命為帕拉伊巴州祕書長，並當選該州代表出席制憲會議與第一屆國會，任期自1891年至1893年。
body.en: Pessoa was born in Umbuzeiro, Paraíba, on 23 May 1865 and took his law degree at the Recife Law Faculty in 1886, the year he was appointed public prosecutor in Bom Jardim. In 1889 he left for Rio de Janeiro; after the proclamation of the Republic he was named Secretary General of the State of Paraíba and was elected a deputy from that state to the Constituent Assembly and the first legislature of the National Congress, serving from 1891 to 1893.

heading.zh-Hant: 部長、最高法院與總檢察長
heading.en: Minister, Supreme Court justice and prosecutor-general

body.zh-Hant: 1898至1901年他在坎普斯·薩萊斯政府擔任司法與內政部長，任內制定了民法典與教育法典。1902至1912年他任聯邦最高法院大法官，其中1902至1905年兼任共和國總檢察長；1912年他主持在里約舉行的國際法學家委員會，審查國際公法與私法法典草案。
body.en: From 1898 to 1901 he was Minister of Justice and Interior in the Campos Salles government, during which the Civil Code and the Education Code were drawn up. From 1902 to 1912 he was a justice of the Supremo Tribunal Federal, and from 1902 to 1905 also Attorney General of the Republic; in 1912 he presided over the International Commission of Jurists in Rio de Janeiro, which examined the draft codes of public and private international law.

heading.en: Senator and the Paris Peace Conference

body.zh-Hant: 1912年他當選帕拉伊巴州參議員，任期記為1912至1919年。1919年他前往巴黎，擔任巴西出席和會的代表團團長，在談判德國賠款並參與創建國際聯盟時贏得聲望；同年，他在凡爾賽期間經米納斯與聖保羅兩大州政治菁英閉門協商而被推選為總統，以補完已故總統羅德里格斯·阿爾維斯的任期。
body.en: In 1912 he was elected senator for Paraíba, a term recorded as 1912 to 1919. In 1919 he went to Paris to head the Brazilian delegation to the Peace Conference, winning fame while negotiating German war reparations and taking part in the creation of the League of Nations; while in Versailles he was chosen for the presidency through a closed-door compromise among the political elites of Minas Gerais and São Paulo, to fill out the term of the deceased president Rodrigues Alves.

body.zh-Hant: 佩索阿於1919年7月至1922年11月出任巴西總統。任內他大力支持聯邦對公路、鐵路、電氣化、東北乾旱救濟與高等教育的投資，同時要面對東北部菁英的政治不和與軍人俱樂部不滿成員。1922年是第一共和不穩定持續加劇的轉折年，現代藝術週、第一次尉官叛亂與獨立百年博覽會都在這一年。
body.en: Pessoa was president of Brazil from July 1919 to November 1922. As president he strongly supported federal investment in roads, railways, electrification, northeastern drought relief and higher education, while contending with political discord among northeastern elites and disgruntled members of the Clube Militar. The final year of his presidency, 1922, was a watershed in the steady destabilization of the First Republic, with the Modern Art Week, the first tenente revolt and the Centenary Exposition all taking place.

heading.zh-Hant: 卸任後的國際與參議院職務

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後，他於1923至1930年任海牙國際法院成員，並於1924至1930年再任帕拉伊巴州參議員；1927年任泛美法學家委員會主席，1932年任國際公法編纂常設委員會主席。1929年他參與支持瓦加斯競選總統的自由聯盟運動。他於1942年2月13日去世。
body.en: After the presidency he served as a member of the International Court of Justice at The Hague from 1923 to 1930 and again as senator for Paraíba from 1924 to 1930; he was president of the Pan-American Junta of Jurists in 1927 and of the Permanent Commission for the Codification of Public International Law in 1932. In 1929 he took part in the Liberal Alliance campaign that supported Getúlio Vargas for president. He died on 13 February 1942.
